text:
The 2026 midterms are too important to sit out. More than 80,000 elections will shape our future, and our communities are ready to make their voices heard. Join our biggest Party at the Polls yet and help bring joy, community, and power to the ballot box.

Add your name to join Michelle Obama on the When We All Vote team. We’ll send you important updates on how you can get involved and join our push to get every eligible American to vote in each and every election.
